g.text: C Separate cohort means and simultaneous intervals
A did not meet independent confirmation
Cora / fixed split / 10% / SGC source / GCN target; all seeds retained
Intervals: two 97.5% two-sided t intervals per cohort; simultaneous 95%. No pooling.
Confirmation requires >=4/5 joint directions and both intervals in their prescribed directions.
